items.title: The Trade Desk and Dstillery Link AI Agents to Reshape Audiences Mid-Campaign
items.excerpt: The Trade Desk and Dstillery connected their AI agents so audiences can be built and reshaped mid-campaign; buyers like the speed but question whether agentic integrations meaningfully change media buying.

items.title: Google AI Mode Now With Up To Four Ads
items.excerpt: Google can now show up to four Google Ads inside a single AI Mode response, following its earnings-call pledge to show more ads, more often, in AI Mode.

history_match.title: Ads in AI Mode expand to new markets.

items.title: Microsoft Clarity Gains Agentic Analytics & Ask Clarity
items.excerpt: Microsoft Clarity added agentic analytics, an Ask Clarity assistant and a brand-agent expansion, saying AI agent visits to sites nearly doubled in three weeks to almost 2 million.

history_match.title: Checkout appears in 25% of AI agent sessions vs 15% for humans, Clarity finds

items.title: Google AI Mode Adds Booking & Quote Links For Home Services
items.excerpt: Google AI Mode now links home-service searches straight to booking and quote pages through partners, raising questions about lead fees for local businesses.

items.title: TikTok Shop AI estimates extra orders per listing fix ahead of Black Friday
items.excerpt: TikTok Shop's AI now estimates how many extra orders each listing fix would bring, and US sellers get AI-made product videos and photos in minutes ahead of Black Friday.

items.title: Shopify revenue gains 32% to $3.7bn as AI-referred orders rise 3.3x
items.excerpt: Shopify said orders referred by AI assistants rose 3.3x in Q3 as merchants sold $119.1bn through the platform, a data point on how much commerce AI agents now drive.

items.title: Smartly's Intelligence Pro flags where extra ad spend may stop paying off
items.excerpt: Smartly launched Intelligence Pro, four planning and measurement tools including Headroom, which uses INCRMNTAL data to flag where extra ad spend hits diminishing returns; Hearst Newspapers tested it.

items.title: This Ad Tech Company Wants To Ensure Brands Don't Go Viral For The Wrong Reasons
items.excerpt: Digital Culture Group's model-driven Resonance Studio forecasts how an ad will land with audiences and flags likely objections before launch, aiming to stop offensive creative before it runs.

items.title: AI Labels Don't Tell Consumers Whether An Ad's Claims Are Real
items.excerpt: Opinion: a generic 'made with AI' label tells consumers AI built an ad but not where reality ends and fiction begins, so disclosure should be claim-level.

items.title: Levi's claymation holiday campaign celebrates handmade craft amid AI bloat
items.excerpt: Levi's 'Let's Get Fuzzy' holiday spot was shot in claymation at four hours of filming per second of animation, positioning handmade craft against the flood of generative-AI ads.

items.title: Google makes big plans for wallet
items.excerpt: Google wants its digital wallet to hold receipts, track orders and arrange refunds, positioning it as the payment layer for AI agents shopping on consumers' behalf.

history_match.title: OpenAI Wants ChatGPT Ads to Become a Permanent Line Item in Agency Media Plans

items.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
items.excerpt: Uber said only four people booked a ride through an AI agent during its busiest week last quarter, a reality check on agentic commerce as a customer-acquisition channel.

items.title: Roku Beta Launches AI-Driven Advertising Platform
items.excerpt: Roku launched Roku Outcomes in beta, an AI-driven platform that optimizes streaming-TV campaigns for actions like app installs; all nine beta flights hit target CPA, with a median 38% below target.

items.title: Adthena Report Shows ChatGPT Ads Surged to More Than 200,000 Placements Ahead of First AI-Driven Holiday Season
items.excerpt: Adthena's Holiday AI Paid Search Report finds ChatGPT ads went from zero to more than 200,000 placements in months and maps how paid search now splits across ChatGPT, AI Overviews/AI Mode and classic Google.

history_match.title: Ecommerce confronts AI shopping agents ahead of holiday season

items.title: Nooks Secures $500 Million from General Catalyst and Launches Node, the First AI Personal Assistant for Sales
items.excerpt: Sales-agent platform Nooks launched Node, an AI personal assistant for sales reps that handles prospecting, outreach and follow-through; the release also announces $500M in non-dilutive capital (funding angle is noise).

items.title: 네이버, 통합 에이전트 구축 앞당긴다…카카오·배민도 자연어 AI 검색 확대
items.excerpt: 네이버가 검색·쇼핑·지도를 하나로 잇는 '통합 에이전트' 구축을 앞당기고, 카카오·배민도 대화형 AI 검색을 확대하며 플랫폼 경쟁이 검색에서 추천·예약·결제 '실행'으로 옮겨가고 있다.

items.title: “매대보다 피드, 진열보다 AI 답변”…日 글리코가 본 K푸드 새 승부처
items.excerpt: 글리코 APAC 마케팅 총괄은 소비자가 소셜에서 제품을 발견하고 AI로 비교·선택하는 만큼 식품 브랜드가 AI 답변 안에서 선택받을 기반을 갖춰야 한다고 말했다.

items.title: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Is At 20% Of Google Search Volume
items.excerpt: OpenAI's Adam Fry said ChatGPT's search-like query volume is now about one-fifth of Google's and grew from 1B to 1.2B in two months, context for where search ad budgets may shift.
